name: Vicious Betrayal — "for each creature sacrificed this way" is entered by hand
notes: Sweep group 7 (2026-10-07). Counts of things done "this way" (sacrificed, discarded, revealed, tapped, exiled, paid) cannot be read off the board; such boosts always added 0. They take the same hand-entered number as the blocker counts (about two dozen cards). Two creatures sacrificed: the Bears are 6/6.
